name: Bulk Discount Calculator
description: Unit cost, base price, quantity tiers, discount percentage, per-order overhead and shipping subsidy. Use all-units tier pricing and label it clearly. Revenue = quantity times tier price; profit = revenue minus quantity times unit cost minus order costs.
